title: Guests are not redirected from product builder pages at the edge
steps: Without cookies, GET http://127.0.0.1:3002/products/create, /products/edit, /products/scan, and /orders as a control.
expected: Builder pages redirect guests to /login?return=… like /orders, /profile/edit and /business/create do.
actual: The '/products/' public prefix (for product detail pages) also matches /products/create, /products/edit and /products/scan, which are not in AUTH_ONLY_PREFIXES; they answer 200 to guests. The API still requires sign-in, so no data is exposed.
impact: A guest can open the product form and only fails on save (what the page shows is checked in Wave 3). Inconsistent with the documented 'builder pages remain auth-gated at all times'.
fix: Add '/products/create', '/products/edit' and '/products/scan' to AUTH_ONLY_PREFIXES (or match /products/[id] only), and add cases to the existing publicPaths tests.
